gates.name: single_myocardial_cell
gates.question: Does the preferred-length controller shorten one myocardial DCM cell with central forces, controlled volume, transverse response and a closed power ledger?
gates.falsifier: Required shortening depends on passive gamma, produces non-central torque, or violates the registered residuals.

gates.name: myocardial_cell_chain
gates.question: Can three independent cells transmit a prescribed mechanical activation sequence while steric and frozen material tethers remain objective and balanced?
gates.falsifier: Persistent penetration, unintended tether birth/death, topology jump, or force/moment drift.

gates.name: myocardium_ECM_sandwich
gates.question: Does myocardial basal adhesion transmit contraction to ECM without an artificial normal source or support-owner conflict?
gates.falsifier: ECM owns the support, a manual normal q is needed, pair forces do not cancel, or j_myo is nonzero.

gates.name: endocardium_ECM_sandwich
gates.question: Are pressure and WSS applied only to endocardial apical faces and transferred to ECM while chi_E stays outside mechanical power?
gates.falsifier: Direct blood load reaches ECM, pressure leaks tangentially, WSS leaks normally, or chi_E enters the mechanical ledger.

gates.name: minimal_complete_patch_verification
gates.question: Can the complete 6-endocardial-cell, ECM and 9-myocardial-cell patch close topology, ownership, resultant, orientation, contact and power checks?
gates.primary_support: outer and perimeter-lateral myocardial compliant ports
gates.falsifier: A fully fixed boundary is needed, ownership is duplicated, a registered ablation is omitted, or a mechanistic result is treated as physiological.
